title: Anthropic
description: Connection to the Anthropic Messages API (or a compatible endpoint), for chat turns. Chat requests name the connection and a model explicitly; there is no default model.

anthropic.description: Identifier flag of the anthropic connection type

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Anthropic API key; stored encrypted and returned masked as "********" (send the mask or omit the key to keep the stored value)

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the Messages API including the version path; defaults to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/

max_tokens.title: Max output tokens
max_tokens.description: Output token limit of a request when the agent version sets none; defaults to 8192

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: HTTP timeout of chat requests; omitted or larger than the turn deadline = the turn deadline (dmstr_neuron_ai.turn.deadline_seconds)

models.title: Models (endpoint without a Models API)
models.description: Only for an endpoint without GET /models, such as Claude on Microsoft Foundry: the model or deployment names, e.g. ["claude-sonnet-5-5", "claude-haiku-5-5"]. The scan lists them as given, without a request, so the health check does not reach the endpoint either. Empty or omitted = ask the Models API

tool_models.title: Models released for tools
tool_models.description: Models of this connection that agents with MCP tools and POST /chat with mcpConnections may use, e.g. ["qwen3:14b", "gemma4:26b"]; llama3.2 also matches llama3.2:latest. Empty or omitted = every model. Checked at agent publish and on POST /chat, after the tools capability of the model catalogue
